concepts.why: Patient has a newly diagnosed extensive ulcerative colitis with four episodes of bloody diarrhea daily.
Patient has a 3-year history of type 2 diabetes mellitus with elevated plasma glucose and hemoglobin A1c.
Patient had a prior percutaneous coronary intervention for acute myocardial infarction 2 months earlier.
Patient has swelling of the pancreas with a peripheral rim and slight narrowing of the main pancreatic duct.
Patient has elevated serum IgG4 and swelling of the pancreas, which may indicate autoimmune pancreatitis.
Patient has elevated plasma glucose and hemoglobin A1c, which may indicate diabetic ketoacidosis.
Patient has swelling of the pancreas with a peripheral rim and slight narrowing of the main pancreatic duct, which may indicate chronic pancreatitis.
Patient has a history of acute myocardial infarction and percutaneous coronary intervention, which may indicate cardiovascular disease.
